chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to him, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu'man narrated to me, from Ali ibn Asbat, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whatever faults our Shiites may have, they do not have any of the following three things: none of them beg with their hand, none of them are miserly, and none of them are gay.

key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shiites (the community of the Shiites)
key_terms.يُؤْتَى فِي دُبُرِهِ: is visited in his rear (referring to homosexuality)

ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics that the Shiites do not have according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defining the spiritual and social identity of the Shiites through the absence of three specific traits: begging (signifying self-reliance and dignity), stinginess (indicating generosity), and being 'given in the rear' (a term of endearment for effeminacy or homosexuality, often interpreted as a sign of moral softness or specific sexual deviance). This hadith serves as a criterion for distinguishing the true followers of the Ahl al-Bayt by highlighting their distinct character traits in contrast to the broader society.
